title: causalFailure.attemptId carries received grant ids inside the Begin and restart-checkpoint idempotency keys
outcome: causalFailure.attemptId carries received grant ids inside the Begin and restart-checkpoint idempotency keys
acceptance: The coordinator's reading is recorded on this item: the idempotency key is a structural identifier, and the grant ids it embeds are identifiers already persisted in card.grantId, not secrets. Either the item closes on that reading, or a change shows a digest of the key in the persisted and rendered causal record while the exact key stays available to the attribution checks.
